nodes.title: Surface Web

nodes.title: IP: which network address?
body: Source IP and destination IP

nodes.title: TCP / UDP: how is data transported?
body: Byte stream / datagrams

body: Read transport protocol and port together

nodes.title: Service: what function is offered?
body: A running application handles requests

footer: Understand each layer, then follow one exchange.

nodes.title: IP：送到哪個網路位址？
body: 來源 IP 與目的 IP

nodes.title: Client → Server: SYN
body: Request a TCP connection
Synchronize the initial sequence number

nodes.title: Server → Client: SYN + ACK
body: Send its own SYN and acknowledge the peer
Each direction has a sequence space

nodes.title: Client → Server: ACK
body: Complete the typical three-way handshake
Continue with application data

nodes.title: As needed: TLS / application login
body: HTTPS establishes a secure channel

footer: Each layer has its own state, rules and evidence.

nodes.title: Client → Server：SYN

nodes.title: Server → Client：SYN＋ACK
body: 回應自己的 SYN 並確認對方

nodes.title: Client → Server：ACK
body: 完成典型三向交握

nodes.title: 依服務繼續：TLS／應用登入

footer: 每一層處理自己的狀態、規則與證據。

nodes.title: TCP: a byte stream
body: Ordered delivery, acknowledgments, retransmission

nodes.title: UDP: datagrams

nodes.title: Choose by application requirements
